notes: Reference date 2018-02-28. Governing document for parental leave: Provost's Parental Leave Policy for Faculty (2018_09, capture 2018-02-23), university-wide. The AS&E Faculty Handbook ch. 5 pages (2018_00 to 2018_08, captures 2018-02-23 to 2018-03-10) and the AS&E Leave Eligibility chart PDF (2018_11, dated 10/8/2015, capture 2017-08-02, linked from the 2018 pages) supply the AS&E rules: teaching relief, the unpaid parental leave and option (a)/(b), medical and family illness leave, sick time, tenure deferral. AS&E (Arts and Sciences plus Engineering) is main campus (V3).

Navigation or index pages with no policy: 2018_01 (chapter 5 index), 2018_05 (chart introduction only), 2018_17 (chapter 4 index). Academic leaves (sabbatical, junior faculty research leaves, supported research leaves, academic leave without pay, multiyear academic leave; 2018_02-2018_04) are professional-development leaves a parent cannot take for a birth: not components. Domestic violence leave, jury duty and military leave cannot be used for a birth: not components. The Trustees' tenure policy (2018_16) has no extension provision.

Path of the coded member (U8): tenure-track/tenured, full-time benefits eligible, two years of service. Other path (less than one year of service): parental leave up to 8 weeks; sick, vacation or personal time may cover it; if sick time is exhausted in the first two weeks, the University pays the first two weeks; the rest unpaid; teaching relief automatic for an 8-week leave in the first year; FMLA does not apply in the first year.

Pay of the 12-week parental leave (c1): the Provost policy makes sick time optional ('may choose to apply') and the University continues salary once it is exhausted (R1c: counts in full). The chart describes it as paid 'using available paid sick time'. After a leave paid with sick time, up to three sick days are retained.

Option structure (R15b): chart rows 2 and 4 offer, instead of the 12-week paid leave, (a) 2 paid weeks at the arrival of the child plus 10 unpaid weeks within the first 12 months, or (b) 12 unpaid weeks within the first 12 months. Coded as the 12-week unpaid parental leave (c3, in_lieu_of c1) with the 2 paid weeks (c2) within it and also in_lieu_of c1; option (b) is c3 alone. R15b's Tufts example describes option (a) as '2 paid weeks within 10 unpaid weeks'; the text says 'an additional ten (10) weeks', so the 12-week unpaid period (2 + 10) is coded as the container: a reading, reported.

Teaching relief timing alternatives (R15b, Tufts 2018 example): c4 (balance of the semester of the leave, containing it, R3b) and c5 (following academic year after a mostly-summer leave, after it, R3d), linked in_lieu_of.

Birth parent chain: parental leave 12 (paid; within the semester of teaching relief c4, or followed by teaching relief c5 in the following year) with FMLA 12, Massachusetts Parental Leave Act 8 and medical leave up to 6 months (paid sick time within) all concurrent from the start; alternative to the paid leave: unpaid parental leave 12 with 2 paid weeks within it.

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave 12 (paid; within c4, or followed by c5) with FMLA 12 and the Massachusetts Parental Leave Act 8 (coverage of the non-birth parent ambiguous) concurrent; family illness leave 6 (paid sick time within) concurrent with FMLA; alternative: unpaid parental leave 12 with 2 paid weeks within it.

Documents cited but not saved: Tufts University Employee Handbook (FMLA section, Family Sick Days, Small Necessities Leave Act, Military Leave Under USERRA); Massachusetts Parental Leave Act text and the MCAD website page; Domestic Violence Leave policy on the Provost's Office website; the full Paid Sick Time policy on the Provost's Office website; Tufts HR Benefits website (LTD); Policy on Second and Fourth Year Review Deferral for Parental Leave (AS&E handbook ch. 4); Statement 1, Statement 11 and Statement 12 of the Faculty Committee on Tenure and Promotion; Policy Prohibiting Tenure at More Than One Institution; Faculty Handbook Chapter 2 (tenure status); Engineering Non-Academic Leave Request Form and Nonacademic Leave Request Form; Application for Academic Leave Without Pay; CBA for Full-time Lecturers, Article 14 Section 5d; the PDF versions of the Provost policies.

Tenure deferral for parental leave: the tenure-chapter page (2018_14) still requires primary-caregiver status and an application before the arrival of the child; the March 2018 Definitions of Terms (2018_00) state that primary-caregiver declaration is no longer required (July 1, 2015) and set a three-month filing window. Coded from 2018_00 with conflicting_sources (the version note on 2018_14 also says to treat 2018_00 as more current).
Massachusetts Parental Leave Act: no Massachusetts statute is saved among the statute texts (searched file names and text); coded from the handbook's statement, statute_verified false.
Nonacademic leave job protection: 'Job protection is available only for eligible leaves that have been approved'; the documents define no job protection period other than FMLA's twelve weeks.
